en.A docling-serve v1 API server — self-hos: A docling-serve v1 API server — self-hosted, or Docling for IBM watsonx (same API).
en.Base URL of the docling-serve instance,: Base URL of the docling-serve instance, e.g. http://localhost:5001 — or your Docling-for-IBM-watsonx service URL.
en.Checks an async conversion job (submitte: Checks an async conversion job (submitted by “Submit Job”). Returns the converted document when finished, or the current job status otherwise.
en.Comma-separated language hints for OCR,: Comma-separated language hints for OCR, e.g. "de,en". Left empty, the server decides.
en.Convert documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, imag: Convert documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images, HTML, …) to Markdown, docling-document JSON, HTML, DocTags and plain text via a docling-serve v1 API (self-hosted or Docling for IBM watsonx).
en.Converts an uploaded document with a doc: Converts an uploaded document with a docling-serve v1 API and returns the requested output formats (Markdown by default).
en.Derive a heading structure for PDFs from: Derive a heading structure for PDFs from bookmarks, numbering and styles.
en.Document URL (leave one of file/url empt: Document URL (leave one of file/url empty).
en.Document to convert (leave one of file/u: Document to convert (leave one of file/url empty).
en.Downloads and converts a document from a: Downloads and converts a document from a public URL with a docling-serve v1 API and returns the requested output formats.
en.Extra passes that add information rather: Extra passes that add information rather than change formatting. Each costs time, and picture description needs a model the server has to provide.
en.Fail the whole conversion on the first e: Fail the whole conversion on the first error instead of returning partial_success with the pages that worked.
en.Has docling-serve fetch an audio or vide: Has docling-serve fetch an audio or video recording from a URL and transcribe it (ASR), returning timed segments, the speakers it detected, and a rendered transcript.
en.Match recognised table cells back to the: Match recognised table cells back to the PDF text (server default: on). Turning it off can help badly ruled tables.
en.Names the document when the URL does not: Names the document when the URL does not — a share link such as drive.google.com/uc?id=… carries no extension, and the format is read from one. Leave empty when the URL ends in the file's own name.
en.Names the recording when the URL does no: Names the recording when the URL does not — a Drive or Dropbox share link carries no extension, and the format is read from one. Leave empty when the URL ends in the file's own name (…/standup.mp3).
en.OCR engine name, e.g. \"tesseract\". Ser: OCR engine name, e.g. "tesseract". Server default: auto.
OCR preset name. Server default: auto.
en.Optional 1-based page window as start-en: Optional 1-based page window as start-end, e.g. "5-20" ("5-" to the last page, "5" a single page).
en.Parser used for PDFs. Leave empty unless: Parser used for PDFs. Leave empty unless diagnosing a parsing problem.
en.Public URL of the document to convert (P: Public URL of the document to convert (PDF, DOCX, …). ZIP archives are not supported.
en.Re-OCR the pages even where the document: Re-OCR the pages even where the document already has a text layer — the fix for a scanned PDF whose embedded text is garbage.
en.Render each page as an image alongside t: Render each page as an image alongside the converted text.
en.Reports the docling-serve service state: Reports the docling-serve service state (GET /health and /version). Note: v1 servers keep those routes open, so this does not verify the API key — a wrong key only fails on the first real request (or the connection check).
en.Resolution multiplier for page images (s: Resolution multiplier for page images (server default: 2).
en.Return the pictures and display formulas: Return the pictures and display formulas found in the document. The Document Conversion add-on cuts them out of the pages as PNGs; a docling-serve embeds the images it already extracted. Costs a second pass over the pages and makes the response much larger.
en.Run OCR on the pages (server default: on: Run OCR on the pages (server default: on).
en.Sent with docling-serve's fetch of the U: Sent with docling-serve's fetch of the URL, for a source that needs credentials — e.g. Authorization: Bearer <token> for a Google Drive file or a signed link.
en.Server-side cap on converting one docume: Server-side cap on converting one document. Distinct from Timeout above, which is this step's own deadline.
en.Splits a document from an upload or URL: Splits a document from an upload or URL into chunks with a docling-serve v1 API (hybrid or hierarchical chunker) and returns the chunk texts.
en.Submits a document conversion as an asyn: Submits a document conversion as an async job and returns its task id (no waiting). Pair with “Get Result”.
en.Sync (fast documents only; server caps a: Sync (fast documents only; server caps at ~120 s)
en.The document to convert (PDF, DOCX, PPTX: The document to convert (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, HTML, …).
en.The server's DOCLING_SERVE_API_KEY value: The server's DOCLING_SERVE_API_KEY value, sent as the X-Api-Key header. Leave empty for an unauthenticated local server.
URL of the audio or video to transcribe. docling-serve downloads it itself, so the bytes never pass through the workflow.
